title: Time Jump — 09:50, Two Hours on the Clock

fields.scenarioTitle: Flyway — HPAI Control Area, Checkpoints & Depopulation
fields.narration: It is now 09:50 on Tuesday, October 20, 2026. That is two hours since the presumptive result. The Board of Animal Health's quarantine order on IP-1, 'Ridgeline Farm', is drafted but has not been issued. It is waiting for an answer on the 230th Street field lane. Deputies are staffing three checkpoint sites: CR 12 and the two feed routes out of the Larkin mill. The fourth site is due at 10:50, and no deputy is assigned to it. Pell County's two deputies arrive at 11:30. Ritter County cannot send anyone until Wednesday's day shift. The USDA APHIS Veterinary Services area veterinarian in charge and a state incident management team are setting up at the Calder County Fairgrounds west lot. The first depopulation equipment trucks are coming in on the 230th Street lane. The Annex K clocks are still running. The quarantine order is due at 11:50. The control area and all 11 checkpoints are due at 15:50. The producer and consumer notice is due at 19:50. Every IP-1 barn must be depopulated by 07:50 Wednesday. Calls are coming in faster than the Training Room can log them.
worldState: Clock: 09:50, Tuesday, October 20, 2026. Weather is still cold and clear with a light northwest wind.
The county EOC is open at Level 2 in the Public Safety Building Training Room.
The H5 result on IP-1 is still presumptive, and the national reference laboratory in Ames has not confirmed it. The Board is acting on the presumptive result.
The quarantine order on IP-1 is drafted but not issued. It still lists only one access point, the CR 12 main drive. The 230th Street field lane has not been confirmed as a controlled gate.
The CR 12 bridge, 0.4 mi east of the IP-1 drive, is still posted for 10 tons.
Checkpoints staffed: CR 12 at IP-1, plus the two feed routes out of the Larkin mill. That makes 3 of 11.

Checkpoint 4 is due at 10:50, and no deputy is assigned. The two Pell County deputies arrive at 11:30 and have not been briefed on Board permits, the cleaning and disinfection (C&D) station or PPE. Ritter County has no one until Wednesday's day shift.
Two Calder deputies are still tied up at the State Highway rollover crash.

The USDA APHIS Veterinary Services area veterinarian in charge and a state incident management team are setting up at the Fairgrounds west lot. The state's hand-wash and shower trailers are due by 20:50.
The first depopulation equipment trucks are inbound on the 230th Street lane toward the north service gate. That lane has not been gated.

Annex K clocks, measured from 07:50: quarantine order 11:50. Control area and all 11 checkpoints 15:50. Producer and consumer notice 19:50. All four IP-1 barns depopulated by 07:50 Wednesday, October 21.
The full IP-1 trace list from Prairie Gold is still due at 12:20. No new premises has been designated.
The EOC phone log is behind, and calls are waiting to be logged.
fields.facilitatorNote: Make players rebuild the status board from 07:50 and name the three gaps out loud: checkpoint 4 from 10:50 to 11:30, the 230th lane answer the quarantine order needs, and night coverage after the day shift ends. If checkpoint 4 could go more than 2 hours without staff, or the clocks slip, check that the Deputy Director escalates to the Director, and that the Director keeps Level 2 and tells the Board and the state EOC.

instructorNote: This card resets the clock and makes players run their status board from the 07:50 presumptive result. Watch whether they name the checkpoint 4 gap, the 230th Street access answer and night staffing, and whether the Director keeps Level 2 and reports any clock slippage to the Board and the state EOC.
